terminal_record.title: Eric Trump Foundation Fundraising Suspension Dated to December 2016
terminal_record.description_short: The supplied research note dates the foundation’s fundraising suspension to December 22, 2016.
terminal_record.description_medium: The supplied account says Eric Trump announced on December 22, 2016, that his foundation would suspend fundraising, and separately dates a New York attorney general examination to June 2017. It does not establish that the later inquiry caused the earlier suspension or prove that funds were diverted. Both developments remain unverified in this draft.
terminal_record.description_long: According to the supplied account, Eric Trump announced on December 22, 2016, that the Eric Trump Foundation would suspend fundraising operations, including its annual charity golf tournament. The same account places a separate development in June 2017, when New York’s attorney general confirmed that the office was examining questions about the foundation. It does not establish that the later examination caused the earlier suspension. The entry also alleges that the foundation paid Trump business properties for tournament-related services and that the organization later dissolved, but those claims are not independently verified in this draft. Eric Trump had reportedly said his father provided golf-course use without charge; the supplied synopsis says documents showed payments to Trump businesses, but it provides no document or amounts that can be checked here. The relationship among the suspension, the state inquiry, any payments, and later dissolution remains uncertain. This internal draft records those allegations as supplied and does not treat them as findings of wrongdoing or as a proven response to an investigation. Publication eligibility remains false until source evidence is supplied.
